text: China's September PPI rises 5% annually versus 4.5% expected, up from 3.8% in August. CPI increases 0.9%, with core CPI at 1%. Gasoline prices rise 16.6%, while food prices decline 1.7%. Producer and consumer inflation remain separated by 4.1 percentage points.

meta.note: The producer-consumer inflation gap is observed; transmission into downstream prices remains unmeasured.

text: ASML reports Q3 net profit of €4.96B versus €4.1B expected and sales of €11.66B versus €11.72B. Customer demand exceeds planned 2027-2028 capacity, with order interest extending to 2030. Full-year sales guidance rises to €44B–€45B.

meta.note: Interest in 2029-2030 orders is not confirmed bookings; the reported capacity gap reflects company forecasts.

text: The IEA reports September diesel exports down 700,000 barrels daily year-over-year, with Russia and the Middle East down 1.3M barrels daily. Inventories decline amid resilient diesel demand. The agency projects Q4 2026 supply below demand and inventory replenishment no earlier than H2 2027.

meta.note: Inventory recovery timing is an IEA projection; proposed Russian supply volumes are not confirmed delivered quantities.

text: Morgan Stanley reports Q3 EPS of $3.03 versus $2.91 expected and revenue of $20.34B versus $19.95B. Equities trading revenue rises 41% to $5.8B, beating estimates by $909M. Fixed-income revenue falls 7% to $2.01B, while investment banking revenue rises 2% to $2.16B.

meta.note: Equities trading outperformance contrasts with fixed-income and investment banking revenue below estimates.

text: September U.S. CPI rises 0.6% monthly and 3.7% annually, above the 3.6% annual estimate. Core CPI increases 0.3% monthly and 2.6% annually. Energy prices rise 5.2%, gasoline 9.1%, and shelter 0.4%. Headline inflation remains above the Fed's 2% target.

meta.note: The 2% Federal Reserve target formally applies to PCE inflation, not CPI; October rate-hike probabilities are market estimates.

text: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rises over 7 basis points to 5.289%, the 2-year rises over 10 basis points to 4.895%, and the 30-year exceeds 5.60%. September CPI reaches 3.7% annually. Futures-implied odds of an October Fed rate hike increase from 22.1% to 43.7%.

meta.note: Yield changes are intraday observations; futures-implied probabilities are not confirmed Federal Reserve decisions.

text: The Social Security Administration announces a 3.6% COLA for 2027, up from 2.8% in 2026. Average retirement benefits will increase approximately $75 monthly. Adjustments cover about 76 million Americans, with SSI increases beginning December 31 and Social Security increases in January.

meta.note: Individual net benefit increases may differ due to Medicare premiums and other deductions.

text: Bank of America reports Q3 EPS of $0.91 and revenue of $30.12B versus $30.69B expected. Profit falls 17% to $6.93B, including a $1.2B regulatory charge. Fixed-income trading declines 17%, equities trading rises 10%, and net interest income rises 7.9%. Shares fall as much as 8%.

meta.note: Excluding the regulatory charge, EPS is $1.08; the $1.10 consensus may not be directly comparable.

text: Netflix announces layoffs affecting approximately 1,000 employees, or 6% of its workforce, primarily across product, technology, legal, and HR teams. Management maintains its full-year financial forecast and states that investment will continue in prioritized business areas.

meta.note: Layoff implementation dates and departmental headcounts are unspecified; planned investment allocations remain unquantified.
